usedFor: Lodgify holds rental bookings, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers after something like “New Booking”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Status Changed to Booked” in Lodgify, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: It fires only when a booking reaches Booked, so the command skips tentative or declined ones.

watchOut: “Booking Change” fires on every booking update, so a command tied to it can run many times.
